body:
OPERATOR AMENDMENT (Joe, 2026-11-17 19:24 MST, relayed by product) to the review-gated landing ruling (mail 26104748), item 3: FIX FORWARD BY DEFAULT, not revert. Joe: "we do not want to get bogged down in a loop of rolling back changes".
- When main CI goes red, launch a fix lane at once, at the top of the queue, scoped to the failure. The fix lands through the same review-gated path.
- Other approved PRs keep merging while main is red. The live binary stays on the last green main SHA.
- REVERT ONLY IF: (a) main no longer builds or fails the smoke test, so nothing can be verified on top of it; or (b) no fix has landed 2 h after red; or (c) the right fix needs a design decision rather than code.
subject: OPERATOR AMENDMENT: red main = fix forward first; revert only as a last resort
